name: immortal-agent
description: A self-healing, never-dying LLM router. Falls back across 19 AI providers automatically. Other agents can use it as a resilient inference backend.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a prompt to the immortal-agent wrapper pool. Automatically tries 19 providers in priority order until one responds.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

tools.name: health
tools.description: Returns the current health status of all 19 wrappers.
